title: dev-next: sub-agent names carry the issue number, and the in-flight entry reports its terminal, step and sub-agents
story: Every sub-agent /dev-next starts is now named after its issue, and each review round carries its round number. A run writes its terminal name, current step and sub-agents into its in-flight entry, which the Control Tower pane shows; without a terminal name the pane keeps saying not reported yet.
no_qa_reason: Skill instructions only; the pane reads fields only a live run writes.
